scope: Concept GT model import, wheel rig, native cockpit and collision envelope
implemented_by: Codex; user authorized personal repair after repeated failed acceptance
root_causes: Per-axis normalization distorted the complete car
GLB showroom wheel pose was layered with live steering and rolling
Approximate rotated AABB was mistaken for tyre diameter and lifted the vehicle
First-person mode hid the native interior and substituted a generic cockpit
Fallback lamp boxes were added outside the measured collision hull
Native-wheel AABB corners expanded the collision hull beyond geometry
changes: Concept normalized uniformly after resetting authored wheel pose
Baked neutral transforms into unit-scale steering/rolling rigs; calipers do not roll
Native interior, steering rim, column, body, glass and lamp lenses retained
Original instrument screen displays live speed and RPM
Cached geometry footprint follows live steering; no rotated AABB expansion
Head yaw uses vehicle up vector so looking sideways does not tilt the horizon

automated.wheel_cases: 4 wheels x 3 steering angles x 4 roll angles; ground error <0.035 world units; diameter error <0.04; axle stays horizontal
automated.collider_cases: At -0.65/0/+0.65 rad steer, cached dynamic hull envelope matches mesh-derived envelope within 0.01 world units

manual.cold_start: PASS after correcting frontWheelCount temporal access discovered during browser QA
manual.native_cockpit: Original red/black cabin and wheel visible in game, no substitute bulkhead
manual.wheel_roll: Light throttle then hard braking, tyre shape/contact retained
manual.steering: Clockwise wheel on right input, continuous motion, Alt+C returns to center
manual.head_look: Left/right and reset exercised; door/window/roof from native asset
manual.instrument: Actual 16 km/h observed both native screen and HUD; saved moving screenshot shows 10 km/h on both
manual.collision: NPC rear approached with light throttle; nose contact stops vehicle and deducts collision penalty; screenshot saved
manual.frame_sample: 17.0ms mean /25.7ms p95 in one stationary cockpit sample, not a sustained benchmark

blender.execution: Local background Python verified; no MCP required
blender.purpose: Neutral source proportion, driver-eye and axle markers; packed textures; reference only, not runtime rig export

remaining: This round does not certify all other vehicle models or every slope/curb scenario
Collision is a horizontal convex envelope with height-layer filtering, not full mesh collision for concavities
Extreme side look exposes the concept asset's angular upper cabin structure; further interior asset cleanup is still needed
Orbit side camera may be occluded by signs at the collision test point; reverse side was used for contact verification
Other source vehicles still use the legacy body/interior path and need individual conversion
